case.selectHint: Click a suspect, then click a cell to place them (dragging works too).
case.rowColumnHint: 💡 "Row" and "column" are counted across the whole floor plan (like coordinates), not just the suspect's room. "North/south/east/west of X" works the same way: relative to the whole plan.
case.giveUpButton: Give up and see the solution

hint.none: Nothing left to reveal: your plan already reflects every available deduction.

l1.rowColEliminationRow: Someone is already placed on row {{index}}: that row is closed to everyone else.
l1.rowColEliminationCol: Someone is already placed on column {{index}}: that column is closed to everyone else.
l1.lockedCandidatesRow: Someone still unlocated has no possible cells left outside row {{index}}. That row is reserved for them.
l1.lockedCandidatesCol: Someone still unlocated has no possible cells left outside column {{index}}. That column is reserved for them.
l1.relationalFilter: A clue linking two people already rules cells out, even though neither of them is placed yet.
l1.relationalExclusion: Someone denies a link to another person: wherever that link would be unavoidable, they cannot have been.
l1.zoneExclusivityTaken: Someone swears they were alone in their room, yet another person is bound to be in it: that is not where they were.
l1.zoneExclusivityClaimedAlone: A room is already claimed by someone who says they were alone in it: it closes to everyone else.
l1.zoneCompany: Someone swears they were not alone: a room nobody could still join them in is therefore ruled out for them.
l1.nakedSingle: Look for the person who has only one possible cell left.

l2.rowColElimination: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink, through the one-person-per-row-and-column rule.
l2.lockedCandidates: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink: someone else, without even being located, denies them a row or a column.
l2.relationalFilter: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink, because of the clue tying them to another person.
l2.relationalExclusion: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink: on those cells the link they deny would hold, wherever the other person ends up.
l2.zoneExclusivity: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink: a whole room is closed to them, because it cannot hold two.
l2.zoneCompany: It is {{person}}'s options that shrink: in that room, nobody could have been with them.
l2.nakedSingle: {{person}} has only one possible cell left. Up to you to find which one.

l3.rowTaken: {{person}} cannot stay on row {{row}}: {{by}} is already there.
l3.colTaken: {{person}} cannot stay on column {{col}}: {{by}} is already there.
l3.confinedToRow: Every cell still possible for {{confinedPerson}} sits on row {{row}}, so that row is reserved for them and {{person}} must leave it.
l3.confinedToCol: Every cell still possible for {{confinedPerson}} sits on column {{col}}, so that column is reserved for them and {{person}} must leave it.
l3.relationalWithPerson: {{person}} was with {{other}}: only the cells in a room where {{other}} can still be remain.
l3.relationalDirection: How {{person}} lies relative to {{other}} rules out the cells incompatible with every position {{other}} can still take.
l3.relationalDistance: The exact gap between {{person}} and {{other}} rules out the cells incompatible with every position {{other}} can still take.
l3.relational: The clue tying {{person}} to {{other}} rules out the incompatible cells.
l3.relationalNotWithPerson: {{person}} was not with {{other}}: on those cells they would share {{other}}'s room, wherever {{other}} turns out to be.
l3.relationalNotDirection: {{person}} denies lying that way relative to {{other}}: on those cells it would be true for every position {{other}} can still take.
l3.relationalNotDistance: {{person}} denies that exact gap to {{other}}: on those cells it would hold for every position {{other}} can still take.
l3.relationalNot: {{person}} denies the link they are credited with to {{other}}: on those cells that link would be unavoidable.
l3.zoneTaken: {{person}} claims to have been alone, yet {{by}} is bound to be in {{zone}}: so {{person}} was not there.
l3.zoneClaimedAlone: {{by}} was alone in {{zone}}: nobody else can be there, {{person}} included.
l3.zoneNeedsCompany: {{person}} was not alone, yet nobody else can be in {{zone}} with them: so that is not where they were.
l3.onlyOptionLeft: Every other cell for {{person}} has already been eliminated.

l4.rowColEliminationRow: {{by}} already occupies row {{row}}, so {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.rowColEliminationCol: {{by}} already occupies column {{col}}, so {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.lockedCandidatesRow: {{confinedPerson}} can only be on row {{row}}, which is therefore reserved for them: {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.lockedCandidatesCol: {{confinedPerson}} can only be on column {{col}}, which is therefore reserved for them: {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.relationalFilter: The clue tying {{person}} to {{other}} is incompatible with {{cells}}: those cells fall.
l4.relationalExclusion: At {{cells}}, {{person}} could not have denied the link to {{other}}: wherever {{other}} can still be, it would hold. Those cells fall.
l4.zoneExclusivityTaken: {{by}} is bound to be in {{zone}}, where {{person}} claims to have been alone: {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.zoneExclusivityClaimedAlone: {{by}} was alone in {{zone}}: {{person}} cannot be at {{cells}}.
l4.zoneCompany: Nobody can keep {{person}} company in {{zone}}: {{cells}} fall.
l4.nakedSingle: With every other cell eliminated, {{person}} must be at {{cell}}.

l5.nothingToPlace: No cell can be settled for certain yet: keep eliminating.

1.label: Beginner
1.description: Every suspect can be worked out alone, one direct clue is enough.

2.label: Easy
2.description: A few suspects need two clues combined.

3.label: Medium
3.description: You need to place some suspects before you can deduce others.

4.label: Advanced
4.description: Several deduction chains, plus at least two suspects who only resolve relative to each other.

5.label: Hard
5.description: Few direct clues: you'll need to reason by elimination across nearly the whole grid.

6.label: Fiendish
6.description: The biggest cast, the longest chains, and even the fact that no room is empty becomes something you must use.
